items.description: File path with an optional line-range suffix. Forms: "path" (full file), "path:offset:limit" (limit lines starting at 1-based offset), "path:start-end" (inclusive line range). Example: "D:/project/README.md:10-25"

files.description: List of files to read. Each entry is a path, optionally followed by a line-range suffix (:offset:limit or :start-end).

line_numbers.description: When true, prefix each line with its 1-based line number followed by ': ' (e.g. '128: content').
